Hon’ble Sharad Kumar Sharma, J.
Mr. Yashpal Singh, Advocate on behalf of 
Mr. Neeraj Garg, Advocate for the revisionist. 
Revision No. 144 of 2019, was admitted by 
the Coordinate Bench of this Court on 19th
December, 2019. 
In this Revision, no notices have been issued 
to the respondent. 
Since Mr. Piyush Garg, Advocate is 
appearing in connected Civil Revision No. 140 of 
2019, he accepts notices on behalf of the respondent 
in Civil Revision No. 144 of 2019. 
Learned counsel for the revisionist is directed 
to supply the copy of the memo of revision to the 
counsel for the respondent within a period of one 
week from today. 
List thereafter. 
 (Sharad Kumar Sharma, J.)
Dated 09.03.2021
Shiv
